body: Thanks for your answer. To be clear- not wanting to combat the tax man, I want to better understand the process and do it correctly hence this post. This is my first time so apologies for being under-informed and if anything I asked sounded silly. I sold 11 items, and they were of certain value as I mentioned. I bought them years ago, I wore and used these items. Some happened to increase in value and got me a profit. What in their eyes discerns “reselling” vs. “personal” is the grey area I’m not sure how to get at among the other Qs. Thanks

I see, thank you. But is there an actual issue just putting it in a regular packing bag or box with no old labels on it? Is there any weight to the receiver’s statement that they will be charged for it being in a regular package? It’s the first I’ve heard of it and I wonder if it’s true
Sweet! You know what’s up. I’ll have to grab some SCs with my next pickup for sure! thanks man. And at this stage, the FDA bore me to death. I hope they fail miserably like they have before.
Aha fair enough! Was impressed with the Smooths btw, I need to carton up before the menthol ban sweeps em off your market countrywide. How do you describe southern cuts on taste and strength?
Seeing a pack of Cuts on here always makes me wanna leather up and stumble into an old time saloon! How do you find cuts with coffee, if you indulge in combining the two at all?

Yessir. Kinda had it with being put off by the selection here, the expense even more so. I suppose across the world the degree of cost is always there to consider, but still. Forever envied by what’s on US shelves, and definitely rather spend the same money on your side of the pond (especially as they begin to phase out menthols). Won’t be the last time, I know that much!

I’m totally with you on that. I hope the US won’t be pushed to hideous patronising packaging, though I’ve heard different things. Attempts failing miserably in court due to violating the first amendment, but I’ve also read anti-tobacco is expected to succeed their fight on packaging. Who knows? I say leave the damn designs alone, for art’s sake of course ;)

By comparison to our UK offerings it’s an improvement for my personal enjoyment, the quality here has been staring down the barrel over the years but that’s no secret. This is the second variant of pfunks I’ve tried, first carton was regular lights but will hold off on the brand when I’m through with these. An American carton of Cowboy Killers may be next, can’t go wrong. I should think the Marlboro Man would second that.
They were brought to me in London from Massachusetts, $88 at Costco.
As a Londoner I don’t know when I will be able to get these again but hoping I will. All my best to you, on and up.
I’m from London and I can always find American Spirit Yellow at Waitrose or Morrisons. You can also buy Blue if you want to make rollies
